# Atlas: the published fleet

> The published fleet as rendered on 2026-09-26, 79 repositories: every public repository that has adopted Atlas, mapped weekly from the repository alone. Each line links a repository's page as markdown, then the same page as data.

For a checked-out repository, `atlas mcp` answers from the checkout itself; this index is only a projection of the last render.
